title: Qualifying papers more often name DIA and human datasets; standard result files show no detectable association
sub: PRIDE datasets released 2013–2022 (n = 20,684) with a qualifying non-primary accession mention during the release calendar year or the next three calendar years (2.3% overall). Qualifying papers name datasets from ≥2 contributor groups and no more than 100 datasets; publication and release order within a year is unresolved. Thermo Fisher only means a single-vendor assignment from instrument labels. Rates are standardised to release year and human status; odds ratios use the adjusted model in Methods. Europe PMC text mining provides an incomplete proxy that does not establish reanalysis.
notes: Open circle: SDRF files were often added after release by reuse projects (91 of 205 predate the format), so direction cannot be read.
